cd /app && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from lib import *

def cry(evs, **kw):
    pre = [key(0, "A", "install"), key(0, "H", "install"), key(0, "Z", "install")]
    return one(pre + evs, **kw)

# crypto: holes + contiguous prefix, highest
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=2, data_hex="0304")]),
                            pkt("A", 1, [F("CRYPTO", offset=0, data_hex="0102")])])]))
print("c1", v["cr"], v["pk"])

# overlapping identical bytes fine
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=0, data_hex="0102")]),
                            pkt("A", 1, [F("CRYPTO", offset=1, data_hex="0203")])])]))
print("c2 identical-prefix", v["cr"], v["pk"])

# conflicting overlap reject
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=0, data_hex="0102")]),
                            pkt("A", 1, [F("CRYPTO", offset=1, data_hex="ff03")])])]))
print("c3 reject", v["cr"], v["pk"], v["conn"])

# conflicting overlap first
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=0, data_hex="0102")]),
                           pkt("A", 1, [F("CRYPTO", offset=1, data_hex="ff03")])])], overlap="first"))
print("c4 first", v["cr"], v["pk"], v["conn"], v["rt"])

# crypto limit
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=31, data_hex="01")])])], crypto_limit=32))
print("c5 limit ok", v["cr"], v["pk"])
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=32, data_hex="01")])])], crypto_limit=32))
print("c6 limit exceeded", v["cr"], v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=4611686018427387903, data_hex="01")])])]))
print("c7 overflow", v["cr"], v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=4611686018427387903, data_hex="")])])]))
print("c8 overflow-empty", v["cr"], v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("Z", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=0, data_hex="01")])])], early=True))
print("c9 crypto at Z", v["cr"], v["pk"], v["conn"])
# levels independent
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("I", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=0, data_hex="aa")]),
                           pkt("H", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=0, data_hex="bb")]),
                           pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=0, data_hex="cc")])])]))
print("c10 independent", v["cr"])
# zero length crypto at high offset
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=5, data_hex="")])])]))
print("c11 zero-len", v["cr"], v["pk"])
# empty data frames are fine, packet with zero frames -> error
v = view(cry([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [])])]))
print("c12 no frames", v["pk"], v["conn"])
